After around 3 months, I noticed my skin texture started feeling different and I also noticed more red blemishes on my face. I stopped using it and everything went back to normal. There are many options for brightening toner out there, I recommend finding a different one.

I've been using the Good Molecules toner religiously for the past three months, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. My skin looks noticeably more even, and the formula feels lightweight on the skin. It absorbs quickly and layers well with the rest of my skincare routine. What I appreciate most is how gentle it is. I have eczema and sensitive skin, and I haven't experienced any irritation or flare-ups since using it. It's hydrating without feeling heavy or sticky, making it perfect for daily use. Overall, this toner has become a staple in my routine, and I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a calming, effective toner especially those with sensitive skin.
